item.title: Old Thunder Horn
item.description: What players would know The Old Thunder Horn is the kind of relic most caravan guards hope is only a road story: a cracked horn capped with fossil tooth and old bronze, said to call something huge and ancient out of mud, rain, and remembered hunger.
